openrouter.note: Rotate :free models. Paid needs paid_enabled=true or a one-shot openrouter_paid approval token.

notes: dry_run_default=true is the safe shipped state: tasks are validated and the exact command is recorded, but no input device is touched.

Keep dry_run_default=true: the live gate is --live plus a single-use token for the exact instruction (bin/issue-approval.sh agent_s_gui_task "..."). dry_run_default only sets the default for tasks that do not ask otherwise; setting it false makes every task live until one asks for a dry run, and the worker's --check flags that as a problem.
Safety keys in this block (enabled, dry_run_default, bind_owner_live_desktop, require_approval_token, max_steps_hard_cap) are read from here only — an environment variable cannot weaken them.
Host knobs (display, geometry, provider, model, grounding_*, timeout_seconds, venv_path) may be overridden in .env; see docs/CONFIG.md.

approvals.note: Empty scopes are rejected; use "*" to authorise any value explicitly.

notes: dai-omni provides continuous self-healing, persistent memory, and unbounded delegation
Memory stores: episodic (events), semantic (facts), procedural (how-to), vector (embeddings)
Healing runs every interval; dry-run by default; approval-gated for sudo/install/git-push
Skill synthesis auto-generates skills from repeated manual patterns (3+ occurrences)
